# xFacts

> Family hub for nutrition labels across the AI stack. x is a variable, not a social network.
> This hub does not host per-label schemas or exemplars. Go to each label domain.

## Labels

| Label | Layer | Question | Agent entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| AppFacts | Body | What is this app built from? | https://appfacts.dev/ |
| ModelFacts | Brain | What went into this model? | https://modelfacts.dev/llms.txt |
| ToolFacts | Toolbelt | What does this instrument touch when invoked? | https://toolfacts.dev/llms.txt |
| AgentFacts | Hands | What may this actor do, and on what leash? | https://agentfacts.dev/llms.txt |
| SkillFacts | Playbook | What will this teach my agent to do? | https://skillfacts.dev/llms.txt |

## Shared rules

- YAML frontmatter is the sole source of truth; Markdown body is the human skim.
- Objective facts only. Prefer `undisclosed` over guessing.
- Specs and schemas are CC0; tooling is MIT.

## Hub

- Site: https://xfacts.dev/
